verdicts.reason: Both crop the photo too tightly. Both lose the dropper bottles, capsules and most of the leaves, and both leave the brush-stroke swatch floating as a stray grey blob, detached from the title it used to sit behind. The bottom third is empty dead space in both. A keeps 'Spa Utopia' and its subtitle as a tight, clean group below the glass. In B the headline runs into the glass jar's rim, the subtitle sits too far below it, and the type is jammed against the left edge, so B is worse.
